name: Greenhouse
desc: Sanctuary and tending; secrets kept in the one place where things are growing.
tags: greenhouse interior, glass roof panels, white iron glazing bars, potting bench, terracotta pots, seed trays, hanging baskets, tomato vines on strings, watering can, coiled hose, gravel floor, condensation on the glass, ferns, bags of compost
prose: the inside of a glasshouse, an iron frame carrying panes overhead, a potting bench crowded with terracotta pots and seed trays, vines climbing strings and condensation beading on the glass
note: Without the FRAME you get a garden - the white glazing bars and the panes overhead are the whole identification. Humidity has to be visible as a thing: condensation, drips, a hose left running. The model also wants to build a botanical-garden palm house, pristine and enormous; compost bags, a cracked pane and a cluttered bench keep it a working greenhouse at room scale.
